header.headline: Architecture built for controlled autonomy
header.subhead: A coordination layer, six specialised agents, local intelligence, and an approval gate between proposal and change. Every capability below is labelled: lab-validated prototype, or roadmap.

layers.title: Sovereign deployment layer
layers.body: The platform is installed and operated inside your infrastructure. Network boundaries, key management, and log retention follow your policy.

layers.title: Local intelligence layer
layers.body: Detection and correlation run next to the telemetry. Data-sovereign by design: raw signal does not leave the environment for analysis.

layers.title: Agent orchestration layer
layers.body: A single coordination plane assigns work across agents, de-duplicates findings, and attaches environment context before anything reaches an operator.

layers.title: Human approval gate
layers.body: Every remediation proposal routes to an authorised reviewer. Approval, rejection, and rationale are recorded.

layers.title: Integration surface
layers.body: Connectors for ticketing, identity, and notification channels. Broadening the connector set is tracked as roadmap capability.

agents.title: The agent roster
agents.note: Agents operate under orchestration and cannot apply changes without passing the approval gate.

items.name: Recon agent
items.mission: Maps the environment: assets, services, and reachable surfaces, so the rest of the system works from a shared picture.

items.name: Surface agent
items.mission: Tracks external and internal exposure of the attack surface and flags material change.

items.name: Identity agent
items.mission: Reviews accounts, privileges, and authentication paths for drift and excessive access.

items.name: Config agent
items.mission: Compares running configuration against intended baselines and proposes corrections.

items.name: Threat agent
items.mission: Correlates verified signals into incidents with context, reducing noise before an analyst sees it.

items.name: Exposure agent
items.mission: Prioritises known exposure by business impact and validates whether compensating controls hold.

capabilities.title: Capability status board
capabilities.note: Lab-validated describes prototype evidence from a lab environment (source: product i18n/observatory, 2026-06). Roadmap describes planned capability. Neither statement is a production SLA.

rows.capability: Human approval workflow with audit trail
Early access programme for design partners

steps.title: Deploy sovereignly
steps.body: Install inside your perimeter under your network and key policy.

steps.title: Agents build the picture
steps.body: Recon, surface, and identity establish a shared environment model.

steps.title: Signals are verified
steps.body: Config, threat, and exposure validate findings before they surface as alerts.

steps.title: Humans approve
steps.body: Remediation proposals reach an authorised reviewer; nothing applies automatically.

steps.title: Posture is measured
steps.body: Before/after comparison is recorded with methodology and date attached.

ctaBand.title: Evaluate the architecture with your team
ctaBand.body: Bring your security architects. We walk the deployment model, the approval gate, and the evidence behind every lab number.
